facts.text: Andrew expressed hope for forming a deep bond with Toby, similar to the bond he feels with his current dog.

evidence.quote: They're pretty lucky to have you as their owner. Hoping for the day I can have such a deep bond with Toby and experience that special bond too.
Sharing something you enjoy with someone is great. Plus, those types of bonds bring loads of joy and love.
